name: carbone-mcp

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List stored templates, with filters and pagination. Each result has an id (Template ID; null for a template uploaded with versioning: false) and a versionId: pass either as templateId to render_document, download_template or delete_template. Each result lists its tags: to find templates by tag, keep the results whose tags include it.

id.description: Filter by Template ID (64-bit format, digits only). Cannot be a Version ID.

origin.description: Upload origin: 0 API (this server), 1 Carbone Studio, 2 Salesforce, 3 Odoo, 4 HubSpot.

includeVersions.description: If true, returns all versions for each template. Default: false (only deployed version).

search.description: Fuzzy search in template names, or exact match on Template ID / Version ID.

limit.description: 1 to 100 results (default 100); use cursor for more.

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous response.

tools.name: convert_document
tools.description: Convert a file to another format, e.g. DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, HTML or Markdown to PDF, or any document to PNG. No data is merged: Carbone tags such as {d.name} stay as written (use render_document to fill them). Example: { "file": "/Users/me/report.docx", "convertTo": "pdf" }. To check a layout, convert to png: the image is returned inline (for HTML or SVG, converter "C" with formatOptions { "Scale": 2 }). Returns text and images (png, jpg, gif, webp) inline; other formats are saved to a temp file whose path is returned.

file.description: The file to convert. An absolute local path ("/Users/me/report.docx", "~/report.docx"; a bare name like "report.docx" is read as base64), an HTTPS URL, or the file as base64. Formats: DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, ODT, ODS, ODP, ODG, HTML, XHTML, XML, SVG, IDML, MD, TXT, CSV, RTF, PDF; not the legacy binary DOC, XLS or PPT (re-save them as DOCX, XLSX, PPTX).

formatName.description: Same values as the string form.

formatOptions.description: PDF: { "EncryptFile": true, "DocumentOpenPassword": "s3cr3t" }, { "Watermarks": [{ "text": "DRAFT", "opacity": 0.2 }] }, PDF/A { "SelectPdfVersion": 2 } or { "PageRange": "1-5" } (converter "L"). Images: { "PixelWidth": 1200, "Scale": 2, "Quality": 80 }. CSV: { "fieldSeparator": ";" }. All options: get_capabilities.

convertTo.description: Output format, e.g. "pdf". Valid outputs depend on the input format (HTML converts to pdf or png, not xlsx; doc, xls and ppt are output only). With options: { "formatName": "pdf", "formatOptions": { ... } }.

converter.description: Converter, used whenever the format changes. "L" LibreOffice (default): every format, and the only one with PDF/A, page ranges and accessibility. "I" Carbone ICE: DOCX and ODT to PDF, the fastest (keep "L" for WEBP or EMF/WMF images, SmartArt, complex charts, comments, form fields, equations, bookmarks, endnotes, and ODT tracked changes or footnotes). "O" OnlyOffice: DOCX, XLSX, PPTX to PDF. "C" Chromium: HTML and SVG to PDF, PNG, JPG, WEBP. Details: get_capabilities.

reportName.description: File name without extension, taken literally (no tags), e.g. "contract".

hardRefresh.description: If true, run the converter even for the same format, and recompute pagination. Set automatically for PDF to PDF with formatOptions (password, watermark, PDF/A), which otherwise come back unchanged.

failOn.description: ["IMAGE_URL_ERROR"] with converter "C": fail when an image of the HTML or SVG cannot be downloaded.

outputPath.description: Local path to save the converted document to, e.g. "~/out.pdf"; returns the path and size. Never overwrites a file.

asAttachment.description: If true, return the file itself as a base64 attachment, for any format, instead of the default (temp file or inline).

returnLink.description: If true, return a one-time download link instead of the file, for the user to open (never fetch it yourself). Exclusive with outputPath and asAttachment.

egressAuthorization.description: Authorization header value Carbone sends when it fetches images or styles of the file, e.g. "Bearer abc".

tools.name: render_document
tools.description: Generate a document (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, ...) by merging JSON data into a Carbone template. Pass templateId for a stored template, or template (local path, HTTPS URL or base64) for a one-off render. To change the format of a file without data, use convert_document; unsure which data a template expects, call inspect_template first. Returns text and images (png, jpg, gif, webp) inline; other formats are saved to a temp file whose path is returned. Batches need a webhookUrl the user provides; otherwise render one document per call.

templateId.description: A stored template, from list_templates or upload_template (never guess one): its Template ID (digits, renders the deployed version) or a Version ID (64 hex characters, pins that version). Exclusive with template.

template.description: A one-off template, not stored. An absolute local path ("/Users/me/report.docx", "~/report.docx"; a bare name like "report.docx" is read as base64), an HTTPS URL, or the file as base64. Formats: DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, ODT, ODS, ODP, ODG, HTML, XHTML, XML, SVG, IDML, MD, TXT, CSV, RTF, PDF; not the legacy binary DOC, XLS or PPT (re-save them as DOCX, XLSX, PPTX). To reuse one, upload_template then pass templateId. Exclusive with templateId.

data.description: JSON for the {d.…} tags: an object, a top-level array, or a reference to a JSON file (local path, HTTPS URL or base64). Omitted: every tag renders empty; to keep tags as written, use keepTags. Tag syntax: the Carbone Skill.

convertTo.description: Output format, e.g. "pdf". Omitted: the template's own format. Valid outputs depend on the input format (HTML converts to pdf or png, not xlsx; doc, xls and ppt are output only). With options: { "formatName": "pdf", "formatOptions": { ... } }.

formatName.description: Same values as the string form.

formatOptions.description: PDF: { "EncryptFile": true, "DocumentOpenPassword": "s3cr3t" }, { "Watermarks": [{ "text": "DRAFT", "opacity": 0.2 }] }, PDF/A { "SelectPdfVersion": 2 } or { "PageRange": "1-5" } (converter "L"). Images: { "PixelWidth": 1200, "Scale": 2, "Quality": 80 }. CSV: { "fieldSeparator": ";" }. All options: get_capabilities.

converter.description: Converter, used whenever the format changes. "L" LibreOffice (default): every format, and the only one with PDF/A, page ranges and accessibility. "I" Carbone ICE: DOCX and ODT to PDF, the fastest (keep "L" for WEBP or EMF/WMF images, SmartArt, complex charts, comments, form fields, equations, bookmarks, endnotes, and ODT tracked changes or footnotes). "O" OnlyOffice: DOCX, XLSX, PPTX to PDF. "C" Chromium: HTML and SVG to PDF, PNG, JPG, WEBP. Details: get_capabilities.

timezone.description: IANA time zone for :formatD dates, e.g. "America/New_York". Default "Europe/Paris".

complement.description: Extra data for {c.…} tags (company details, constants), or a reference to a JSON file.

variableStr.description: Aliases for the whole template, e.g. "{#buyer = d.order.customer}", then {$buyer.name} in it.

reportName.description: File name without extension; may use tags, e.g. "invoice-{d.id}" (taken literally with keepTags).

enum.description: Labels for :convEnum(TYPE), e.g. { "STATUS": { "1": "Active" } }, or a reference to a JSON file.

translations.description: Strings for {t(key)}, selected by lang: { "fr-fr": { "hello": "Bonjour" } }, or a reference to a JSON file.

currencySource.description: ISO 4217 currency of the amounts in data, for :formatC. Set with currencyTarget and currencyRates.

currencyTarget.description: ISO 4217 currency to convert the amounts to.

currencyRates.description: Rates per currency, base 1: { "EUR": 1, "USD": 1.08 }, or a reference to a JSON file.

keepTags.description: If true, skip templating: tags stay as written, to proof a template's layout. Exclusive with data.

hardRefresh.description: If true, recompute pagination and the table of contents after rendering. Needs convertTo.

batchSplitBy.description: One document per item of an array: "d" when data is the array, "d.items" for a child array; at most 100. Needs a webhookUrl the user provides.

batchOutput.description: Batch result: "zip" (default, named after reportName, or batch.zip without one) or "pdf", one concatenated PDF (needs convertTo "pdf").

batchReportName.description: Name of each file in the batch ZIP, without extension; tags resolve per item, e.g. "invoice-{d.id}".

preReleaseFeatureIn.description: Turn on Carbone pre-release features up to this version tag, e.g. 5000000.

failOn.description: ["IMAGE_URL_ERROR"]: fail when an image URL cannot be downloaded, instead of showing a placeholder.

webhookUrl.description: Only an endpoint the user owns and gives you: Carbone POSTs { "success": true, "data": { "renderId" } } to it when the document is ready, and that server downloads it once. This call then returns no document.

webhookHeaders.description: Headers Carbone sends to webhookUrl, e.g. { "authorization": "secret" }.

egressAuthorization.description: Authorization header value Carbone sends when it fetches images, PDFs or the webhook while rendering.

outputPath.description: Local path to save the generated document to, e.g. "~/out.pdf"; returns the path and size. Never overwrites a file.

asAttachment.description: If true, return the file itself as a base64 attachment, for any format, instead of the default (temp file or inline).

returnLink.description: If true, return a one-time download link instead of the file, for the user to open (never fetch it yourself). Exclusive with outputPath and asAttachment.

tools.name: inspect_template
tools.description: List the Carbone tags a template uses and return a sample JSON dataset matching its structure. Call it before render_document when you do not know which data a template expects. Pass templateId (a stored template) or template (local path, HTTPS URL or base64). It counts as one render on the account; {t()} tags are not listed.

templateId.description: Template ID (its deployed version) or Version ID, from list_templates. Exclusive with template.

template.description: A template to inspect, not stored. An absolute local path ("/Users/me/report.docx", "~/report.docx"; a bare name like "report.docx" is read as base64), an HTTPS URL, or the file as base64. Formats: DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, ODT, ODS, ODP, ODG, HTML, XHTML, XML, SVG, IDML, MD, TXT, CSV, RTF, PDF; not the legacy binary DOC, XLS or PPT (re-save them as DOCX, XLSX, PPTX). Exclusive with templateId.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the template categories in use, for the category filter of list_templates or upload_template.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List the tags in use across templates. To find the templates with a tag, call list_templates and keep the results whose tags include it.

tools.name: upload_template
tools.description: Store a reusable template, then render it with render_document and its Template ID. Returns id (Template ID) and versionId. A new version of an existing template (id) is used by renders only once deployed (deployedAt).

template.description: The template file. An absolute local path ("/Users/me/report.docx", "~/report.docx"; a bare name like "report.docx" is read as base64), an HTTPS URL, or the file as base64. Formats: DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, ODT, ODS, ODP, ODG, HTML, XHTML, XML, SVG, IDML, MD, TXT, CSV, RTF, PDF; not the legacy binary DOC, XLS or PPT (re-save them as DOCX, XLSX, PPTX).

name.description: Display name, shown and searched by list_templates (max 200 characters).

id.description: Template ID (digits) to add this upload to as a new version; omitted: a new template. Never a Version ID.

versioning.description: Leave true (default). false is legacy: no Template ID, only a SHA-256 templateId.

tags.description: Labels, e.g. ["sales", "billing"]: sorted, deduplicated, 100 characters in all.

sample.description: A sample dataset stored with the template, at most one: [{ "data": { "name": "Acme" } }].

deployedAt.description: 42000000000 deploys this version now: renders by Template ID use the most recently deployed version.

expireAt.description: Delete the template at this UTC Unix time (seconds); 0 (default) never. To delete now, use delete_template.

tools.name: update_template_metadata
tools.description: Change ONE template version: name, comment, category, tags, deployment (deployedAt), scheduled deletion (expireAt), or the Template ID it belongs to (moveToTemplateId). A Template ID patches its deployed version; a Version ID, that exact version. To delete now, use delete_template.

templateId.description: The version to change: a Version ID, or a Template ID for its deployed version.

moveToTemplateId.description: Only when the user asks to move a version: moves it to this other Template ID (digits). Not the template to change (that is templateId).

tags.description: New tags, replacing the current ones: sorted, deduplicated, 100 characters in all.

deployedAt.description: 42000000000 deploys this version now: renders by Template ID use the most recently deployed version.

expireAt.description: Delete this version at this UTC Unix time (seconds); 0 cancels a scheduled deletion.

tools.name: delete_template
tools.description: Delete a stored template now: a Template ID removes every version, a Version ID only that one. Confirm with the user first: it cannot be undone. To schedule a deletion instead, use update_template_metadata with expireAt.

templateId.description: Template ID (every version) or Version ID (that version only), from list_templates.

tools.name: download_template
tools.description: Download a stored template's original file (DOCX, XLSX, HTML...), or with sample: true the sample dataset stored with it. Text and images come back inline; other files are saved to a temp file whose path is returned.

templateId.description: Template ID (its deployed version) or Version ID, from list_templates.

sample.description: If true, return the sample dataset stored at upload, as JSON, instead of the file; an error if there is none.

outputPath.description: Local path to save the template file to, e.g. "~/out.pdf"; returns the path and size. Never overwrites a file.

asAttachment.description: If true, return a text or image file as a base64 attachment too.

tools.name: get_api_status
tools.description: Check Carbone API health and version. Returns the current API version and a status message. Useful for verifying connectivity and confirming which Carbone version is active.

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Returns a summary of all Carbone capabilities: supported formats, features, tool usage examples, and links to full documentation. Call this first if you are unsure what Carbone can do.

instructions:
Carbone generates documents (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, HTML, images...) from templates and JSON data, and converts files.

- convert_document changes a file's format; render_document merges JSON into a template ({d.field} tags).
- Unsure which data a template expects? Call inspect_template first.
- Carbone tags are their own language (not Mustache or Jinja): never guess the syntax. The Carbone Skill is the reference: the skill://carbone/SKILL.md resource, or https://carbone.io/documentation/developer/ai/skills.md
- Files: local paths, HTTPS URLs or base64. PDF and Office results are saved to a temp file.
- get_capabilities has the formats, converters, options and examples. Docs: https://carbone.io/llms.txt (replace .html with .md on any carbone.io doc URL).
